info.name: Material Asus Router
info.description: Every HTTP route of the app, generated from the source by scripts/build-postman.mjs. Set baseUrl (for example http://198.51.100.2:8790), sign in with POST /api/login, then copy the csrf value from the answer into the csrf variable. The session cookie is kept by Postman. Router passwords and keys are never returned by any route.
